playbooks.description: Confirm scenario-to-cloud exposes the stable packager endpoints deployment-manager orchestration reads: manifest schema, manifest template and preflight requirements.
Validate the manifest template the API returns carries the contract fields a deployment-manager export must satisfy (target, scenario, dependencies, bundle, ports).
Observer check of the bundle inventory and stats endpoints that a deterministic bundle build populates; the build itself is exercised by api/bundle package tests, not by this read-only case.
Preflight publishes the supported OS identity, recommended version and actionable unsupported/compatibility behaviour before any artifact is copied.

Observer check that the deployment listing and scenario inventory the setup plan is generated from are readable; the setup plan apply requires an owned target and is exercised by the QEMU lane, not here.
Observer check that deploy candidates are listable and the API health surface answers with typed readiness; deploy/start against a target is exercised by the QEMU and real-VPS lanes.

Observer check of the read-only inspection surfaces (deployment listing filtered by status, docs manifest) that remote status and log retrieval build on; SSH-backed inspection needs an owned target and runs in the QEMU lane.

Observer journey: open the production deployment page and assert the identity header (environment, target key, transport, deployment id), the release panel, the health panel, the operation panel and the recovery panel are all rendered from API state. Read-only: navigation and assertions only; nothing is clicked. Apply, cancel and restore journeys need the routed test-storage lease (docs/agent-system/routed-test-db.md), which is not installed for this scenario, so they are proven by vitest (ui/src/components/deployments/console/DeploymentConsole.test.tsx) and recorded here as observer-only.

Observer journey at a 360px viewport: the identity header, the operation panel and the recovery panel render and the advanced disclosure toggle stays reachable; no primary action is clipped. Read-only navigation and assertions.

Observer journey: open the wizard and assert the stepper and container render so the manifest → secrets → build → preflight → review flow is reachable. Creating a record, compiling and applying a plan are mutating and need the routed test-storage lease, which is not installed; those steps are proven by vitest (ui/src/components/wizard/StepDeploy.test.tsx) and are not exercised here.
